blurb: Welcome to Inlet BrewBoat, a one-of-a-kind BYOB cruise along the beautiful Murrells Inlet Marshlands. The BrewBoat combines beer, biking, and great music to provide a memorable boating adventure. Our boats can accommodate up to 35 passengers combined (or 15 and 20 each) and is the perfect setting for family, friends, and parties of all types.
extraNote: Gift card sales are final and non-refundable. · Customers will receive a full refund with 72 hours notice of cancellation. · Customers will also have the choice to reschedule in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. · If Guests are unable to reschedule a full refund will be issued. · Thank you for booking with Inlet BrewBoat! Cruises depart from our dock located on the Murrells Inlet MarshWalk behind Creek Ratz Restaurant and the Mullet Hut. Please arrive 10-15 minutes before your scheduled departure time with your beverages. Parking is available next to Creek Ratz or across the street in the gravel parking lot. quotes.author: Becky
quotes.text: We did the early morning coffee, cruise just last Friday. And it was a wonderful experience for us. We highly recommend it, and we plan to do it again. The guy running the boat was knowledgeable, engaging, and very personable. I can’t believe it took me this long to know about this short morning, coffee cruise.
